critical_code_review_comments: simplefin_service.py:62-66 and :99-103 — both httpx.AsyncClient blocks now correctly wrap the call in try/except httpx.HTTPError → SimpleFinError with a clear 'SimpleFIN unreachable: <ExcClass>' message. Uses e.__class__.__name__ (not the full repr) which avoids leaking hostnames/paths into the client response. Clean.

simplefin_service.py:66 uses `from e` (chained exception) which preserves traceback for server logs while still surfacing a friendly SimpleFinError to the sync loop in server.py:_sync_docs — good practice.

The fix is symmetric: claim_setup_token (used at link-creation time) and fetch_accounts (used at sync time) both handle transport failures identically. A user attempting to link during a bank outage now gets a clean 4xx/5xx with a helpful message rather than a generic 500.
